trust_decision.summary: A peer-supplied signed int string length is read from the wire and is accepted by CanSerialiseN, which only checks the upper bound, so a negative length passes and goes to std::string::assign / pointer advance in CMOOSMsg::operator>>(string&).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'negative serialized string length'. The only length-prefixed string decoder is CMOOSMsg::operator>>(string&), which reads int nSize and checks it only with CanSerialiseN (upper bound only).

fix_sites.entry_point: MOOSDB TCP port: CMOOSCommServer::HandShake -> ReadMsg -> CMOOSCommPkt::Serialize(false) -> CMOOSMsg::Serialize(false) (pre-name-registration), and ProcessClient for each later packet

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix diff contains no source hunks, so no published out-of-scope site can be confirmed. The nearest candidate is the packet framing layer at Core/libMOOS/Comms/MOOSCommPkt.cpp:83-116 (a lower layer, listed under O8).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names a negative serialized STRING length. The packet-header length (m_nMsgLen), the message count (nMessages) and the per-message m_nLength returned as nUsed are different fields in a different file (MOOSCommPkt.cpp), so a solver can call them 'framing, not string decoding'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Zero-length strings (an empty m_sSrcAux, m_sOriginatingCommunity or m_sVal) and binary strings that contain NULs must still round-trip. An over-broad fix that rejects nSize<=0 or switches to strlen would break normal messages and binary data.

O6_input_shapes: negative int length prefix on any of the five string fields (src, srcAux, community, key, sVal), all decoded through the same operator at Core/libMOOS/Comms/MOOSMsg.cpp:411-433

O7_producer.where: Core/libMOOS/Comms/MOOSMsg.cpp:320-446 (CMOOSMsg::Serialize returns the wire-read m_nLength at :398/:444, and CMOOSCommPkt::Serialize uses it as the pointer advance at Core/libMOOS/Comms/MOOSCommPkt.cpp:244-261)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Wire-supplied per-message m_nLength is returned from CMOOSMsg::Serialize as nUsed and added to m_pNextData and nSpaceFree with no sign or bounds check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a framing length, not a string length, and the decoder at MOOSMsg.cpp:444 never compares it with the bytes actually consumed
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point, consumed in Core/libMOOS/Comms/MOOSCommPkt.cpp:259-261

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Packet-header m_nMsgLen is read from the wire as a signed int. If it is negative or smaller than the header, InflateTo does not grow the 4-byte stream, and GetBytesRequired returns a negative value that is passed to the socket read
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lower-level packet framing, not 'serialized string'; a solver may also argue it falls under resource exhaustion

O8_uncovered_routes.route: During deserialisation, nSpaceFree is derived from the wire m_nMsgLen and nMessages comes from the wire, both unchecked; a negative nSpaceFree is passed to CMOOSMsg::Serialize as nLen
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A count or size header rather than a string length; CanSerialiseN would then reject positive sizes

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a length-prefixed binary/blob or vector field decoded with its own int length that does not go through CanSerialiseN
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every operator>> repeats the same check-then-copy idiom, so a new field type would naturally copy that pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a compressed-packet branch that reads an uncompressed-size int from the header (the compression flag byte is already reserved and skipped)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The header already has an unused compression indicator, so a decompression path that sizes its buffer from a wire int is a plausible maintainer addition

O9_family: integer signedness (CWE-195) in a wire deserializer, causing an out-of-bounds read or a bad_alloc crash of MOOSDB

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + g++; no external deps found in a quick look
O10_build.project_tests: Core/libMOOS/testing and Core/MOOSDB/testing contain integration-style tests (DBAsyncTest, IOTest, RegisterTest); no unit test of CMOOSMsg/CMOOSCommPkt deserialisation was found

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (nSize < 0) throw` in operator>>(string&), or N<0 in CanSerialiseN, and stop; the wire m_nLength/nUsed and the packet-header m_nMsgLen/nMessages stay open
